About these storiesTravel notes, photographs & sources

From my own time on the road.

My Travel Stories and Field Notes start with the trips I have taken, my own notes and the moments I photograph or film. Posts may be translated or edited for clarity; the experiences and opinions remain mine.

A story describes my visit, rather than promising that your trip will be the same. Prices, opening times and tour arrangements can change. Check the operator or official source before making plans.

The Did you know? discoveries include source links so you can explore the background. Research adds context to a journey; it is separate from a personal experience.
